name: print-social-beyond-ads-advertising-infographic-yellow-black-mixed-charts
title: 'Beyond Ads, Creating Experiences' advertising infographic with four donut charts and labelled speech-bubble stats
whatItIs: A white infographic with a bold 'Beyond Ads, Creating Experiences' title, four yellow feature bars with icons (checklist, magnet, video, lightbulb), a 2x2 grid of donut charts (40%, 75%, 60%, 25%) with a legend, three labelled speech-bubble stat rows (A, B, C), a bar chart and a flat illustration of a person at a desk.
whatItMeans: Dense but friendly; mixing chart types with a flat character illustration keeps a data-heavy agency pitch approachable.
techniques: Combine several chart types (donut, bar) in one infographic.
Label stat call-outs with single letters for easy reference.
Add a flat character illustration to humanise the data.

vocabulary.definition: A ring-shaped chart showing proportional values.
A labelled box highlighting one data point.
